Sofia / Julian —

See attached: redline_MSAs_combined.docx. High level summary of our position:

- Single Exhibit F: acceptable, provided the order form language references the exact tier IDs and usage metrics (we can't leave it to a spreadsheet that isn't incorporated).
- Burst surcharge triggers: we've proposed objective thresholds (e.g., >150% of committed monthly tokens over a 24-hour rolling window) rather than vague "spikes". This ensures predictable invoicing.
- Liability/credits: tightened the SLA credit cap to mirror the committed capacity in the order form (we bracketed figures for commercial review).
- Audit & logs: kept Redwood's standard audit access clause but added an opt-in for encrypted log delivery for regulated customers (optional, can be removed).

Inline comments: see pages 3–5 of the redline doc; there are two items highlighted that require LumenX finance confirmation: 1) whether the proposed 150% trigger is acceptable; 2) whether you need a different invoicing cadence for burst charges (monthly invoice vs. immediate reconciliation).

If those two items are confirmed, Marissa will incorporate the agreed numbers into the consolidated order form and return a near-final PDF.

On the timing front: we can turn the consolidated order form around within one business day after your confirmation on trigger + invoicing cadence.

Laura Bennett
